text_block_list.text:
On the road back from our outing. 
Suddenly, Fusaichi Pandora showed me a 
map.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Trainer☆ Let's go to the mountains! The 
mountains♪
choice_data_list: A mountain? Why?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
The other day, Kuu-chan senpai showed me 
photos from when she went mountain 
climbing~♡

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"Jeez, it looks totally photogenic! I was 
thinking I wanna take pics like this too~ 
♪"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
You know, the sunset from the summit here 
is super famous~! Senpai hasn't seen it 
yet either, apparently~.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
If we leave right now, the timing will be 
just right! Right? Right? Please say yes!

The mountain she mentioned is a low one, 
reachable in under an hour. With 
chairlifts and paved trails available, 
it's an easy climb.
choice_data_list: Then shall we go check it out?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Phew~~~~! The air tastes so good☆ And look 
at all this greenery~~~~☆
choice_data_list: Looks like the lift is over that way.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Ehh, no way♡ You gotta hike up on your own 
two feet♪ Plus, the scenery along the way 
looks sooo pretty♡

The guide board does list various scenic 
spots along the trail, such as waterfalls 
and suspension bridges. Going around to 
see them sounds enjoyable, but—
choice_data_list:
Are you okay? You won't get tired halfway 
through, will you?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Aha, totally fine, totally fine! Don't 
underestimate a genius!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! So super colorful~~☆ Doesn't that 
mushroom look crazy poisonous?
choice_data_list: It's dangerous, so don't touch it!

It's dangerous, so make sure not to touch 
it!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Alrighty. Though this might actually look 
super photogenic♪

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! Is that rock glaring at me?! Hey, 
hey, are you mad? Are ya mad??
choice_data_list: Haha, yeah, it does look like a face

Fufu, it really does kind of look like a 
human face.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Gotta take a two-shot with the Human Face 
Rock♪ OMG, look at this, completely 
unedited!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Aww, how lovely~~♡ This leaf looks just 
like Ku-chan-senpai's ahoge♡
choice_data_list: You've taken quite a few, huh.
You've taken quite a few, haven't you.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, totally~! I wanna snap up every 
single "insta-worthy" thing that catches 
my eye!

Fusaichi Pandora runs around whenever she 
spots something interesting, snapping 
photos with great care. However, before 
long, as the scenery begins to look the 
same...

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Heeey~~, are we at the top yet~? I'm kinda 
getting bored~.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"Geez, such a pain~~. I wanna eat 
something swee~~t."

Her spirits have visibly dropped, and her 
climbing pace has slowed down. At this 
rate, reaching the summit before sunset 
will be tough, and once it gets dark, 
there's a risk of slipping and falling.
choice_data_list:
Why don't we just give up for today and 
head back down the mountain?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Eeeeh? I don't want that either~! I wanna 
snap an Insta-worthy sunset~!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
I wanna show Kuu-chan-senpai too and hear 
her say, "That's amazing!"
choice_data_list:
Still, if that's the case, we have to 
climb all the way to the summit...

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
I don't wanna climb, but I don't wanna 
miss the photo eitheeeer!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Jeez, do something about thiiiiiis!!
choice_data_list: (Pushing herself way too hard again...)

text_block_list.text:
Once Fusaichi Pandora sets her mind on 
something, she's stubborn. Seeing no other 
choice, I searched for reviews of the 
mountain on my phone—
choice_data_list: (Yeah, this should satisfy them.)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: ? Trainer?
choice_data_list:
Pandora, let's head down the mountain for 
a bit.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Hohe?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Auuugh... Woah. What is this place, it's 
aaamazing...!!

Found through online reviews, this shrine 
midway up the mountain didn't have quite 
the breathtaking view of the summit. And 
yet...

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
The sky is super orange! The torii gate is 
pitch-black and mega photogenicâ¡ The 
contrast is insaneâ
choice_data_list:
Don't you think we could take some totally 
photogenic shots here?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah!! That's awesome!! You totally 
don't have to force yourself to climb it, 
either!!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Camera, stand byyy—okay!! All riiiight, 
today's grand finale is~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: This photo right here☆☆☆

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"Awwwww♡ Kuu-chan senpai, aren't you 
praising me a bit too much~~?"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"Let's climb to the top together next 
time☆" —annnd sent. Ehehe~♪
choice_data_list: Good for you, Pandora!
Good for you, Pandora!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Yup, thanks! Seriously, you were an 
absolute genius today~!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
You know exactly what I want! And you make 
what I wanna do come true!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Suuuuper full marks!! Thou hast earned my 
praise! ☆☆☆
choice_data_list: Ahaha, thank you!
Fufu, thank you!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, what should we do next? Stay on 
the mountain a bit longer? Or head down?
choice_data_list:
Since we're here, wanna take a 
commemorative photo right here?

I'm getting hungry, so shall we head down 
soon?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that's great! We haven't taken any 
pictures of us together yet~.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Then Trainer, come over here! Strike a 
pose... like this♡

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh! I was thinking the same thing! I'm 
totally starviiing~!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, where should we stop by on the 
way home? I'm totally in the mood for 
something sweet~~♡♡♡
